gaps.lead: Pay claims must be submitted before the end of the month.
gaps.sentence: You have ___ your pay claims before the end of the month.
gaps.explanation: 'Must be submitted' becomes 'you have to put in your claims'.

gaps.answer: as close to the beach as
gaps.lead: The hotel was further from the beach than we expected.
gaps.explanation: further than expected = not as close (to the beach) as expected.

gaps.lead: People thought the species had died out completely.
gaps.explanation: 'People thought it had died out' becomes 'it was thought to have died out'.

gaps.lead: The play was so boring that we left early.
gaps.explanation: 'So boring' becomes 'such a boring play that …'.

gaps.lead: Perhaps she never received our message.
gaps.explanation: may/might have + participle = possibility in the past.

gaps.lead: The soup needed a little more salt.
gaps.explanation: needed a little more = didn't have enough (salt).
